system.description: Some constructs have special, unusual attacks (such as poison-gas breath or crushing hugs). The DM can approve, veto, or modify any special attack chosen by the player creating the construct. Each special attack is worth another asterisk (*) and, as always, each asterisk increases the construct's cost).
